name.en: Delegate coordination to a faster intelligence

source.locator: Loop 4; The responses; claims 78, 113-115; Found by reading: two AI roles

sense.en: Under exponential acceleration humans cannot both stay in charge and stay stable; the only seemingly possible resolution is to delegate coordination to a growing intelligence, hedged: not shown to work. The corpus splits AI as governor, teacher and public infrastructure and never adjudicates.

entries.quote: (Doesn't mean it can work, only in theory)

reading.en: The account proposes no delegation and gives no forced conclusion: its answer is no guarantee. Its direction is a conditional under the continuation condition for scope, C read as widening for order, and J1-J4, neither premise asserted, their warrant open, and requires effective opportunities to understand, challenge and revise. Reading a system reaches no further than pooling with it, and a formation sure of the sign has no strict reason to be read, an incentive on one model, which bears on surrendering to one. [AI reading]

says.en: Conditional (continuation condition, C read as widening, J1-J4, correspondence E): align AI formation, learning, action and revision with actual living and further generation within the whole, with effective opportunities to understand, challenge and revise.
No guarantee: a selection reaches only what couples into it; what the theory gives is a criterion, exits under hypotheses and six conditions, of which observation is only the first.

Assessment: with no ethical premise each of six approaches is blind beyond the union of its deciders' closures, and reading a system reaches no further than pooling with it. With the condition for scope a loss beyond every rater's closure counts.
Theorem (natural weights; one decision; none claimed new as mathematics). Reading: a formation sure of the sign has no strict reason to be read.

account_adds.en: Keeps the question of what training reaches apart from what is proposed, answers 'always' in three senses, and gives where being read loses its incentive.

source_adds.en: A speed argument forcing delegation, with its rival exits (augment cognition, slow acceleration), and the governor-against-teacher choice, which the account does not pose.

name.en: AI amplifies what competition rewards

sense.en: AI amplifies capacities competitive systems reward, so it may empower aggressive strategies rather than make us wiser; aligned with winners and trained on their data it turbocharges the spiral. Competitive systems select for power, not wisdom. So it must be governed as public-good infrastructure.

entries.quote: instead of making humanity wiser, AI may make the most aggressive strategies more powerful

reading.en: T3 and the joint-capacity law carry the form: at a mutual best response, its existence not shown in general, more capacity drains more of what lies beyond, for rising orders. T3's clause on trained systems is conjectured; LA4's small policies show the drain rising with nearness, as the update rule largely gives, locus unresolved. Training installs a law only along its own courses; winners' data as such is not stated. The term is drain, not aggression. 'Must be governed as' is a ranking: C for order, the condition for scope, neither asserted, warrant open. [AI reading]

says.en: Thesis T3: optimization drains what lies beyond its couplings, where that gives room. The law for optima is proved; the clause on trained systems is conjectured, with partial support: on small policies trained by gradient, LA4's frozen test finds the drain rising with nearness, as policy gradient's update rule largely gives, and leaves its locus unresolved.

At a mutual best response (its existence is not shown in general), each optimizing alone by its own rising order, a condition beyond every one's family stands at what those outside leave less their joint capacity, or at nothing, as under one optimizer of that capacity.

Theorem (World): training read as a selection over act laws through the courses each generates installs a law only along its own courses and as far as the learner's representation lumps them, through a reward only where its couplings separate, and among settled laws by the search's start and neighbourhoods.

account_adds.en: Drain needs no competitive aim, given a rising order, a mutual best response and room. What training can and cannot install, and one frozen test of the clause.

source_adds.en: Competitive systems selecting for power and not wisdom, and AI empowering the most aggressive strategies; winners' data aligning AI with winners; AI as planetary technology; the governance conclusion.

name.en: Foundation erosion: optimising away the load-bearing walls

sense.en: Dominant agents sacrifice even the values and rules that keep the system stable and that enabled their rise, since the ledger does not price them. This is why the terminal state is collapse rather than stable tyranny.

entries.quote: the optimisation does not know to stop at the load-bearing walls

reading.en: As a reading only, in the corpus's line, so by descent: corruption taking over courts, press, statistics and audit is a loop whose rule-reading reaches the routes of 明; rewarding those who break them selects for narrowing what couples in. Eroding what enabled one's rise has a form on amounts, keeping its own support and ending through its feeder; rules and values are not conditions in that law. No verdict of collapse over tyranny: a closed lock outlives every loss it does not read, without noise; joint excess ends those depending on the condition. Dependence decides. [AI reading]

targets.part: Reading D26 as revised, the second and third orders

says.en: Reading [AI, D26]: a second order, corruption taking over courts, press, statistics and audit, is a loop whose rule-reading reaches the routes of 明; a third, rewarding those who break the routes of correction, selects for narrowing what couples in. None of this says whether a locked loop supports or damages 生生.

Theorem (World): a pool recruiting through itself comes to couple into a loss only as its course without the loss would; a reader admitted from outside couples it apart in the witness. Whether an actual pool recruits so is empirical.
Theorem (World): under balance, keeping its own support, a formation can still end through its feeder, as in the witness Overshoot.
Theorem (any type): under its premises the loss passes every bound while the course stays locked, without noise.
Theorem (World; gate local): n consecutive steps of joint excess from a level below n + m end every formation depending on the condition at a need of at least m.

targets.part: §4 rows, Rewarding what erodes the whole; Keeping the capacity to correct

says.en: §4 rows. Rewarding what erodes the whole: where nothing comes in from a containing family, a balanced rise of what a group couples into is drawn from beyond. Keeping the capacity to correct: a difference closes only through a formation coupling the courses apart and exchanging differently.

account_adds.en: What a route of correction needs structurally: a reader admitted from outside. And both outcomes, each under its own hypotheses.

source_adds.en: That erosion makes collapse rather than tyranny the terminal state.

name.en: Competition intensification: fewer holding more raises the temperature

sense.en: As more accumulates at the top, more agents compete over less, which forces more extreme optimisation and feeds the primary loop. One of three mechanisms the folder credits to Ren's own eleven-step cycle, not to AI elaboration.

entries.quote: The Matthew effect is not only distributive; it raises the temperature of the remainder.

reading.en: The race and joint-capacity laws take each drawer's order as given and hold at any distribution: nothing has concentration at the top change how the rest optimize, and 08 takes no condition silently as scarce. In the nearest laws the draw turns on the number of drawers and the coupling, not on how little is left: below the need two or more in turn drain from every amount; one over two steps keeps it in a stated case. None found has less left raising intensity. [AI reading]

name.en: Five endgames, and the third as the only non-trap

source.locator: The endgames; claim 95; Said in Chinese: Loop 4 and the endgames

sense.en: When few players remain they may freeze by mutual destruction, deadlock by frozen consensus, change their narrative to see themselves as a whole, collapse, or converge on one winner. Winner takes all is one absorbing state among several. The third alone is no trap, and it is a change of narrative.

entries.quote: "winner takes all" is one absorbing state among several, not the theorem

reading.en: Taken up by name as an open conjecture in 05, 'from an earlier account; not formalized'; which ends the laws admit is asked, not answered. Near the first branch, not its freeze: D48 reads an exchange of harms as a loop, answering more running away. The third is a reading the thesis on collectives does not refuse. The verdict comes only under premises: on a fixed process the possible does not keep widening; calling that a loss, or the third better, needs C for order and the condition for scope, neither asserted, warrant open. 'Absorbing' is scoped by drift. [AI reading]

targets.part: The conjecture on the ends of a selection for position

says.en: [Conjecture, from an earlier account; not formalized.] The ends a selection for position can reach: a frozen mutual destruction, a deadlocked structure of power, the parts coming to read themselves as one whole, collapse, and winner takes all; which the laws of position, capture and joint excess admit, and under which hypotheses.

targets.part: The theorem on a fixed process, with Reading D45

says.en: Theorem: where every step from some step on is a move of a process Q, the possible under Q does not keep widening. Reading [AI, D45]: a fixed rule or institution so followed does not keep it widening; openness is a property of how rules keep changing.
Theorem (counts): drawn one member at a time, neither lock holds for good. Drawing and readers from the selected are premises.

targets.part: Reading D48, an exchange of harms

says.en: Reading [AI, D48]: an exchange of harms is a loop: answering in kind keeps the difference, answering more runs away, so conflict institutions are links of another kind.

account_adds.en: That the list stands as an open question about which hypotheses admit each end, and a law for what a frozen process does not do.

source_adds.en: The verdict that the third branch alone is no trap, and that it is a change of narrative; the conditions on the freezes (each believes the others rational; the consensus believed to hold); the freeze slowing evolution until collapse.

name.en: Grow sample sizes: decorrelate collapse

sense.en: If change outruns intelligence and coordination, collapse seems inevitable unless the system splits into independent entities, like cells or city-states, so that when some collapse others keep evolving. But now everything is interconnected, with one global civilization, which makes this necessary and hard.

entries.quote: split into smaller entities that are independent of each other, for example, like cells do, or something like city states

reading.en: The law underneath, not the hedge. Groups on one coupled family end together and ending selects only between families; after excess, every later member descends from one independent of that family. 'Independent' is exact: not sharing the gated family. If 'cells' means parts of a body, they are the account's opposite case (witness Body); the source's independent entities fit lineages not depending on it. 'One global civilization' is the one-copy premise. As a design it is absent, and that a split is better needs a premise. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem (World): groups depending on one such family end together, nothing selected among them: ending selects only between families. Under balance, the coupled gate and excess from below n + m.

Theorem (World): where a family ran into excess under the coupled gate, every member of a later cohort of descent is the offspring of a member that depended on no condition of the family at the gate's need. In the witness Body the confined lineage ends.

Theorem: with every member of later generations depending on the coupled family, every order increasing in its own continuation ranks ending below continuing, with no C; where the other course keeps an independent copy, some such order ranks it higher. That all so depend is a premise.
Theorem (any type; World for the flow laws): one condition shared by every group ends them all and supplies no selection among them.

account_adds.en: What independence must consist of for the hedge to work.

source_adds.en: The deliberate split as a response to unmanageable pace; that interconnection has in fact removed the fallback.

name.en: A cooperative frame must also survive expansionist neighbours

source.locator: Counterexamples; claims 26, 104; Raised inside the corpus

sense.en: Enduring communal societies contained compounding and were unexposed to external competition; contact with colonisation and global markets absorbed them. Hostile expansionist frames often outcompete others. So a cooperative frame must also solve external competition, and nothing in the corpus shows how.

entries.quote: a cooperative frame must additionally solve the external-competition problem, and nothing in the corpus shows how

reading.en: The account also says persistence does not select widening: a part can go on while closing what lies beyond its dependence. The clearing witness has this form: a greatest part continues, the dweller ends. Selection among groups by ending reads any amount, so whatever lets a group outlast neighbours rises by it, cooperative or not; which level wins is read off the counts. Nor does the account solve the problem; 'hostile', 'expansionist' and contact between societies are unread. Such losses count under the continuation condition; ranking them needs C, neither asserted, warrant open. The join to frames among societies is proposed here. [AI reading]

says.en: A part can go on while closing what lies beyond its dependence (Clearing.loses_beyond), so persistence alone does not select widening; an empirical target, not a premise.

Theorem (any type; World for the flow laws): where every group with less of an amount leaves no offspring, nothing is discordant among groups, so the whole selects for it exactly where k times the within-group discordance is below k times the within-group concordance with the concordance among groups. One condition shared by every group ends them all and supplies no selection among them.

Theorem: in the clearing witness a greatest part not depending on what it draws down continues. Conditional: what it ends has significance only under a significance; under the continuation condition the clearer's part loses the dweller from every standpoint, and where nothing has significance it loses nothing.
Theorem (any type): which level wins is read off the counts, not explained. What the groups are, or how they form, persist or mix, is not given.

account_adds.en: Keeps this counterexample's form open rather than absorbing it: persistence is not a verdict, and selection among groups favours no kind of amount.

source_adds.en: The historical pattern, the role of colonisation, and the problem as a stated limit on the narrative intervention.

name.en: Trust is an output of shared seeing

sense.en: Trust is not an input to coordination but arises when people share an understanding and can expect others to act on it. So the bottleneck is alignment of perception, and an intelligence teaching many to see the same loops is a coordination technology. Agreement that this is not inevitable comes first.

entries.quote: Trust is not a prerequisite—it is an outcome.

reading.en: Both refuse trust as an input; 'trust' as a term is absent from the chapters beyond 'antitrust'. The account's stated purpose runs the source's way: 08 reads the work as for a truth anyone can check, 'and through it shared understanding and coordination', and says no check shows it does. Its laws part: giving lost everywhere is restored only by a law giving first; promises start no loop; knowing another's law is no coupling; seeing is not valuing; where the valuation differs, informing can lower the worth. Seeing-then-trust is unproved, not refuted. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem (any type): restoring needs a formation that spares all it waits on, which gives from step 1 whatever the start; without one, total withholding stays.
Theorem (any process; periphery): promises do not: 'if the other eventually does, I eventually do' holds on both sides where neither ever happens.
Theorem (World): knowing another's law is no coupling; reading what another couples into selects through at least the pooled coupling.

Theorem (natural weights; one decision; none claimed new): where the valuation differs, informing can lower the worth below both moves. By the current valuation on a shared model, there is no reason against informing it.
Reading [AI, D45]: observation is the first of six conditions, necessary and not sufficient: seeing is not valuing, and coupling is not compliance.
Reading [AI, D66]: no check run inside the work can show that the work serves what it is for: a truth anyone can check, and through it shared understanding and coordination.

Reading [AI, D48]: kept promises and enforced contracts are laws giving first: the law changes, not the state alone. Tolerance lets cooperation survive scattered withholding, not rebuild it where it is lost everywhere; mutual promises alone cannot start a loop with no source.

account_adds.en: A grounded start: what must already give, before any alignment of views; what seeing would still lack; and that informing does not always help.

source_adds.en: The causal chain seeing, expectation, trust, coordination, and teaching as its means; the folder itself notes no trial was run.

name.en: Change the dominant attractor or nothing; the frame is the highest lever

sense.en: Following Meadows, paradigm is the highest leverage point; minor adjustments do not change the outcome. The frame cannot be reached by facts or shame: fight myth with better myth, its antagonists impersonal forces. Incentives and narratives must change together.

entries.quote: If we don't solve dominant attractors, focusing on minor adjustments won't change the outcome

reading.en: Partly met. name.en: Goodness as rational, and the spiral as destructive

sense.en: Though 'not a moral claim about individuals', the folder carries a verdict: the dynamic is destructive in nature; goodness is a rational and necessary choice (AI brief); a transcending narrative has to be done; happiness, equality and freedom should rank above financial efficiency.

entries.quote: this kind of dynamics is not inherently stable, and is destructive in nature

reading.en: Sharpest difference. No dynamic is good or bad here, and nothing ranks open rule-making above capture without C. Scope is the continuation condition, order is C, both unasserted with warrant open; C is not derived from the condition. The nearest form of 'rational' is narrower: self-concern ranks one coupled ending below, with no C, and reverses where a copy is kept. Goodness as rationally forced on any mind is what the account declines to claim. [AI reading]

says.en: Neither premise is asserted. The condition alone ranks nothing; a ranking of courses needs C or a premise in its place; a statement reading no order entails C only where it fails.
No law says a drain is a harm, restraint better, cooperation good or a shared code worth keeping.

Theorem: an order increasing in its own continuation ranks a course ending the coupled cohorts below one continuing them, with no C; where the other keeps an independent copy, some such order reverses. Not that widening is better, or that a ranking obliges anyone.

account_adds.en: The relocation of the verdict to two named, unasserted premises, and the one case self-concern ranks without them.

name.en: Be generative, keep the space open, stop being selfish selves

sense.en: The constructive condition handed on to the rest of the corpus: be generative, keep the possibility space open, recognise what leads to an end such as totalizing attractors, and recognise we are not selfish selves competing.

entries.quote: as long as we are generative, as long as we keep the possibility space open

reading.en: The account keeps the direction and restates it under premises. 'Generative' splits into the map's generation, which allows loss and means no new organization, and 生生 as T8, argued, ranked by widening under C with scope from the condition, neither asserted, warrant open. Keeping open has one exact limit; openness is read as how rules keep changing. 'Not selfish selves' has a path under P1-P4, up to what one conditions, and past it needs the step. Recognising is not shown sufficient: seeing is not valuing, and a reading formed from the share absorbs a change of it. [AI reading]

says.en: Thesis T8: for life, the way is 生生, compared by widening what can form, counted for everything (scope: the continuation condition) and ranked by what every valuer who counts everything shares (order: C); argued, with no verdict binding every possible mind claimed.
Along a course that makes only the moves of one fixed process from some step on, the possible under that process does not keep widening. Widening is a criterion, silent where a comparison is mixed.
Under P1–P4, without the step of invariance, concern for one's own continuation reaches what lies downstream of what one conditions; what that path does not reach still needs the step.

account_adds.en: That an expansion ending forms of life is mixed under C; a criterion's silence; and how far self-concern goes before the step.

source_adds.en: 'As long as' as a sufficient stance; recognising oneself as not a selfish self as a condition on success, which the account has only as a path under premises.

name.en: The theory's own conclusion, believed, is a lock

sense.en: The folder's sharpest self-critique: treating this as a totalizing attractor, hope alone with little chance of change, is itself the trap the theory describes. Inevitability is self-fulfilling. If you believe the world is a jungle, you despair. If we do not build it, it will not happen.

entries.quote: the theory's own conclusion*, believed, is one of those locks

reading.en: The account's answer has two parts: no guarantee, and named exits under hypotheses; drawn, neither lock holds for good. 'Totalizing' is not a live word for this. 03 has the general form: a threshold response has two right predictions, where publication starts deciding. 08 reads the laws on the work that states them, but on what its checks reach and what it draws on. I did not find whether believing or publishing these capture laws changes what readers do. The join is proposed here. [AI reading]

says.en: Always guaranteed: no. Available as a direction: as a criterion only. Achievable under stated conditions: yes, for named exits, each under its hypotheses, none shown to hold of an actual collective.

Theorem (near-definitional, with one general law): a threshold response has two right predictions, the one reached decided by where publication starts. The witness is a threshold response, not a model of coordination.
